title: Kathy S NDE 6376
content: I was struggling to breathe. I could feel myself fading away: the room faded out and everything was focused on just trying to breathe. I realized I couldn't see anything. My thoughts were getting fuzzy: everything in me was just focused on trying to breathe. I could hear my husband's voice and just kept struggling to breathe. Then I realized I couldn't feel my arms or my legs or any part of my body, just this horrible chest pressure and struggling to breathe. Then all of a sudden, I felt a ‘Whoosh’ and suddenly everything was perfectly clear. My mind felt sharp and alive and I felt wonderful. Then I realized I wasn't breathing, and I didn't need to breathe. I had no body. For some reason I felt like I was floating above the bookcase in my room, but I couldn't see anything. It was all dark. I felt wonderful, sharp, and alive, completely at peace. I knew without a shadow of a doubt that everything was just fine; everything was exactly how it was meant to be. It was an incredibly peaceful and yet energizing feeling. I was still completely. Then I realized that I had no body, and I felt like ‘No, I am not leaving my daughter.’ I have three kids but for some reason it was really important that I not leave the 2 year old. I thought I started to see a little light in the distance, and it is hard to describe how I felt, but it was almost like I felt stubborn, like ‘I will not go into that light. I am not leaving. I am not ready.’ Then it was like SLAM, I was suddenly back in my body and I could hear the medics saying, ‘It is okay, we are putting in the tube,’ and I realized I was intubated.

out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: Felt like she was floating above the bookcase in her room.
out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Reported a sudden 'Whoosh' followed by feeling 'perfectly clear', 'sharp and alive', 'wonderful', 'completely at peace', and that she 'didn't need to breathe' and 'had no body'.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Heard husband's voice and later heard medics speaking during return; experienced darkness and then perceived 'a little light in the distance' and refused to go into it.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE in darkness with heightened clarity occurred before perceiving a distant light; no tunnel or life review reported; return occurred immediately after deciding not to leave her daughter.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Out-of-body state described as blind/dark ('I couldn't see anything. It was all dark.') while still feeling mentally 'perfectly clear' and 'sharp and alive'.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “Whoosh” ... “I wasn't breathing, and I didn't need to breathe. I had no body.” / “No, I am not leaving my daughter.” / “I will not go into that light.” / “Then it was like SLAM, I was suddenly back in my body.”
